Background | Information

Context Import | The | development | of | mobile | lighting | tools | can | be | traced | back | to | the | early | stage | of | the | development | of | human | society | - | primitive | society | . | Since | humans | learned | to | drill | wood | to | make | fire, | mobile | lighting | has | experienced | the | development | process | from | fire, | oil, | candles | to | flashlights | . | Mobile | lighting | tools | have | experienced | countless | changes, | from | torches, | oil | lamps, | candles, | kerosene | lamps | to | incandescent | bulb | flashlights, | xenon | bulb | flashlights, | and | to | a | wide | range | of | LED | flashlights | .

Context Import | Oil | lamps | were | the | easiest | lighting | tools | to | use | at | that | time | . | At | this | stage, | in | addition | to | using | oil | lamps, | human | beings | also | tried | their | best | to | find | other | lighting | tools | . | Around | the | 3 | rd | century | BC, | someone | made | candles | out | of | beeswax | . | In | the | 18 | th | century, | candles | made | of | paraffin | wax | appeared, | and | mass | production | began | with | machines | .

Context Import | The | British | invented | the | gas | lamp | more | than | a | hundred | years | ago, | which | made | the | human | lighting | method | take | a | big | step | forward | . | Movable | lighting | tools | such | as | torches, | candles, | oil | lamps, | and | gas | lamps | are | not | separated | from | the | fire, | and | are | all | illuminated | by | the | light | emitted | by | the | burning | of | substances | . | At | the | end | of | the | 19 | th | century, | Edison | invented | the | electric | light, | which | has | rewritten | the | history | of | human | lighting | since | then, | and | mankind | has | entered | the | era | of | electric | lighting | .
Knowledge | Introduction

New Knowledge | Modern | civilization | should | indeed | thank | the | American | inventor | Thomas | Edison | for | making | the | first | white | lamp | with | commercial | value | and | bringing | light | to | mankind | . | Likewise, | Conrad | Hubert | deserves | the | same | respect | for | inventing | the | flashlight | more | than | a | hundred | years | ago | so | that | we | can | shine | wherever | we | are | .

New Knowledge | When | Hubert | came | home | from | get | off | work, | a | friend | proudly | showed | him | a | glittery | planter | . | It | turned | out | that | he | installed | a | battery | and | a | small | light | bulb | in | the | flowerpot | . | As | soon | as | the | switch | is | turned | on, | the | bulb | illuminates | the | flowers | and | looks | dazzling | . | Hubert | was | fascinated, | and | the | incident | was | a | revelation | to | him | . | He | sometimes | walks | in | the | dark | at | night, | and | it | is | very | inconvenient | for | him | to | step | up | and | down | . | Not | long | ago, | he | had | to | carry | a | heavy | oil | lamp | to | the | dark | basement | to | find | things | . | He | thought, | wouldn't | it | be | practical | and | convenient | if | he | could | use | an | electric | light | to | illuminate | his | body? | So, | Hubert | put | the | battery | and | light | bulb | in | a | tube, | and | the | result | was | the | first | mobile | flashlight | .

New Knowledge | The | flashlight | is | a | hand | - | held | electronic | lighting | tool | . | A | typical | flashlight | has | a | battery | - | operated | bulb | and | focusing | reflector, | and | has | a | handle | - | style | housing | for | hand | - | held | use | . | Although | a | fairly | simple | design, | it | was | not | invented | until | the | late | 19 | th | century | because | it | had | to | combine | the | invention | of | the | battery | with | the | light | bulb | .

New Knowledge | Today, | flashlights | have | many | functions | besides | simple | lighting | . | Some | can | adjust | the | brightness | of | the | light, | some | can | flash | reminders, | and | some | can | change | color | or | adjust | the | lighting | area | . | But | even | if | the | flashlight | has | so | many | functions, | it | may | not | meet | your | requirements, | so | today | we | use | the | Intelligent | Eye | to | make | a | multi | - | functional | flashlight | .
